The elevated byproduct fraction seen in effluent analysis is a consequence of incomplete conversion, not a root cause. The decisive test was holding temperature/pressure constant while varying PSC: only PSC changes moved the outcome. Recommended fix: increase ParticleSizeCat to ~125 (extrapolating the dose-response curve) and monitor. If further gain is needed, titrate to 150, but avoid over-sizing as mechanical bed fluidization effects could reverse the trend.
